note: Single source for design tokens. Colour and shadow only in v0.1-M2-B0; typography, spacing, radius, border width and motion are tokenised when a screen consumes them. Every entry carries the ruling that produced its value — see docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-01-goproceed-v0.1-m2-b0-foundations-design.md. Colours never carry baked-in alpha: React Native's shadowOpacity multiplies with a colour's alpha, so an rgba() string passed as shadowColor renders nothing.

line.ruling: Owner ruled at a render, 2026-08-03: the document's value, #D9DBD5, opaque. Borders do not composite. This is the cheaper branch for React Native: one value, no per-surface pre-composited variants, and no compositing logic anywhere in the native module — a translucent line would have needed a hand-authored blend per surface it sits on (paper, white, ink-950), because React Native authors border colours opaque and has no custom properties to composite through.

shadow.nativeBlurDivisorNote: CSS blur radius is roughly twice React Native's shadowRadius sigma. This approximation is deliberately kept here, reviewable in the source, rather than hidden inside a generator.

shadow.ruling: Owner ruled at a render, 2026-08-03: the document's single shadow, 0 8px 30px rgba(21,23,25,.07) — not the shipped six-step ladder (packages/ui/src/tokens.css:33-36,42-43). The document defines one shadow, so the source carries one shadow token, named `shadow` to match the document's own naming, which has no scale suffix. No further elevation steps are invented around it: a token with no consumer is an untested assertion, and B0's single screen (apps/mobile/src/screens/token-proof.tsx) uses no shadow at all — further steps arrive in B1 when a screen needs them. androidElevation is hand-authored at 3, because Android's elevation encodes offset, blur and opacity in one scalar and cannot be derived from the CSS value: Material's scale puts a bare resting surface at ~1dp, and this shadow's 8px offset and 30px blur describe more separation from the page than that minimal geometry even at only 7% opacity, so 3 sits one deliberate step above resting rather than at it — nowhere near a floating dialog's 24dp.
